description: P1.9 Snowflake/dbt publication contract for trusted Account and Person identities, governed values, relationships, opportunity inputs, history, and unresolved evidence.

published_models.canonical_identity_crosswalks: Current approved source-to-canonical mappings from the latest complete P1.8 publication.
published_models.canonical_accounts: One row per approved Account identity with only governed canonical values promoted.
published_models.canonical_people: One row per approved Person identity with unowned CRM values left as evidence.
published_models.canonical_account_source_history: Every staged company version connected to an approved Account mapping.
published_models.canonical_person_source_history: Every staged person version connected to an approved Person mapping.
published_models.canonical_field_conflict_evidence: Preserved non-authoritative lifecycle disagreements for P1.4 review.
published_models.unresolved_identity_records: Latest Account and Person source rows without an approved mapping.
published_models.resolved_person_account_relationship_inp: Person-to-Account relationship evidence only when both identities are approved.
published_models.canonical_opportunity_inputs: Source-neutral Opportunity/Deal inputs with an approved primary Account link where available.
